Here a monastery of really enormous dimensions, and built according to a splendidly conceived plan, has been entirely laid bare, and Readers will find a detailed description of the results, with a fine site-plan, in the present volume. Next day the Khan-i Khanan appeared before the Emperor, and offered to undertake the erection of the bridge at his own cost in commemoration of that nocturnal adventure of his sovereign.
